data.narrative:
Bravo Ordnance is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $3.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses total capital raised ($3.6M) as a proxy base and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $9M valuation. Peer-Median triangulates across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). The median valuation across this set is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide spread, reflecting material uncertainty at this stage. The triangulated analysis implies a range of $8M to $460M, with a median of $204M. The Stage-Progression method ($9M) anchors a conservative floor based on deployed capital and typical progression mechanics. The Peer-Median result ($400M) reflects the higher end observed in the Defense & Security peer set, though peer heterogeneity is substantial. Key uncertainties include definition of comparable stage equivalence, peer selection methodology, and whether early-stage capital deployed correlates meaningfully to later-stage valuations in this sector. Further diligence on Bravo Ordnance's product differentiation and market traction would be required to narrow this range.
